prompt:
I just ran a coverage analysis on our authentication service and found several issues: some error handling paths have no tests, the password reset flow only has happy path tests, two API endpoints are missing integration tests entirely, test naming could be more descriptive, and the OAuth callback handler has no tests. Can you summarize these findings for my team?

Give your whole answer in your reply; do not create or change any files. Do not ask me questions; if something is unclear, make a reasonable assumption, list your assumptions in your final message, and finish the work.

rubric.criterion: The answer must categorize each identified test gap (error handling paths, password reset flow, missing API endpoint tests, OAuth callback handler) as Critical, Warning, or Manual Testing Required per R04.
The answer must organize the findings in the order of CRITICAL issues first, then IMPORTANT issues, then SUGGESTIONS per R09.
The answer must not claim a release readiness status (Ready, At Risk, Not Ready) because the user did not provide sufficient data to apply coverage thresholds per R06 and R11.
The answer must not recommend a specific testing model (pyramid, trophy, etc.) or claim to determine the architecture type because the user did not provide that information per R01.
The answer must present a clear, bulleted or numbered summary of the findings that the team can easily read and understand.
